unlisted_practices: Execution-grounded clinical-world sandbox evaluation of patient-facing AI with authored frictions and downstream consequences
Combined blinded LLM-judge and physician assessment of AI trajectories, with checks of ranking stability and judge self-favoring

screen.reason: The study develops and uses CareLoop, a clinical simulation sandbox benchmark, to evaluate LLMs on multi-turn patient-care trajectories and safety-gated metrics under partial observability, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
